probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein the user interface provides a visual comparison between the distribution of assets of the investment portfolio and the benchmark risk category to enable assessment of risk alignment__.

2. (Original) The system claimed in claim 1, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment.

3. (Original) The system claimed in claim 1 or claim 2, wherein said user interface shows the sum of the distribution of assets in each asset class of said asset classes of the investments of the investment portfolio.

4. (Currently amended) A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in __modifying__ an investment [[addling an investment]] to investment portfolio.

5. (Currently amended) A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in __modifying an investment by__ removing an investment from the investment portfolio.

6. (Currently amended) The system claimed in claim 4 or claim 5, said system for performing the step of __determining and__ allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to an investment of the investment portfolio __based on the risk analysis__.

7. (Currently amended) A system for creating an investment portfolio for an investor, said system for performing the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) generating user interface data for display of a user interface on a user terminal, the user interface showing a plurality of investments and including means for selecting investments for inclusion in the investment portfolio; and (c) generating further user interface data for display of another user interface, said another user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein the another user interface enables visual assessment of risk alignment between the investment portfolio and the benchmark risk category__.

8. (Original) The system claimed in claim 7, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment.

9. (Currently amended) The system claimed in claim 7 or claim 8, said another user interface including means for __determining and__ allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to each investment of the investment portfolio __based on comparison with the benchmark risk category__.

10. (Original) The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers.

11. (Original) The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares.

12. (Currently amended) A computer program for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said program for performing the step of generating a user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein the user interface provides a visual comparison between the distribution of assets of the investment portfolio and the benchmark risk category to enable assessment of risk alignment__.

13. (Original) The computer program claimed in claim 12, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment.

14. (Original) The computer program claimed in claim 12 or claim 13, wherein said user interface shows the sum of the distribution of assets in each asset class of said asset classes of the investments of the investment portfolio.

15. (Currently amended) A computer program for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said computer program for performing the steps claimed in any one of claims 12 to 14 and performing the step of __modifying__ an investment [[addling an investment]] to investment portfolio.

16. (Currently amended) A computer program for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said computer program for performing the steps claimed in any one of claims 12 to 14 and performing the step of __modifying an investment by__ removing an investment from the investment portfolio.

17. (Currently amended) The computer program claimed in claim 15 or claim 16, said computer program for performing the step of __determining and__ allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to an investment of the investment portfolio __based on the risk analysis__.

18. (Currently amended) A computer program for creating an investment portfolio for an investor, said computer program for performing the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) generating user interface data for display of a user interface on a user terminal, the user interface showing a plurality of investments and including means for selecting investments for inclusion in the investment portfolio; and (c) generating further user interface data for display of another user interface on said user terminal, said another user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein the another user interface enables visual assessment of risk alignment between the investment portfolio and the benchmark risk category__.

19. (Original) The computer program claimed in claim 18, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment.

20. (Currently amended) The computer program claimed in claim 18 or claim 19, said another user interface including means for __determining and__ allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to each investment of the investment portfolio __based on comparison with the benchmark risk category__.

21. (Original) The computer program claimed in any one of claims 18 to 20, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers.

22. (Original) The computer program claimed in any one of claims 18 to 20, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares.

23. (Original) A computer readable data storage medium, including the computer program claimed in any one of claims 12 to 23 stored thereon.

24. (Currently amended) A method of analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) arranging investments of the investment portfolio to show a distribution of assets of each investment of said investments over one or more asset classes; and (b) determining the degree to which the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments corresponds to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein the determining step includes generating a visual comparison between the distribution of assets of the investment portfolio and the benchmark risk category__.

25. (Original) The method claimed in claim 24, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment.

26. (Original) The method claimed in claim 24 or claim 25, wherein said step of determining includes the step of determining the degree to which the sum of the distribution of assets in each asset class of said asset classes of the investments of the investment portfolio corresponds to the distribution of assets over each corresponding asset class of the asset classes of the benchmark risk category.

27. (Original) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 26, wherein said step of arranging is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

28. (Currently amended) A method of managing an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 27; and (b) __modifying__ one or more of the investments [[changing one or more of the investments]] in response to said step of analysing so that the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments of the investment portfolio corresponds more closely, or less closely, to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of the benchmark risk category of the investor.

29. (Currently amended) A method of managing an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 27; and (b) __determining and__ changing the proportion of investor's assets allocated to each investment of the investment portfolio __based on the risk analysis__ so that the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments corresponds more closely, or less closely, to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of the benchmark risk category of the investor.

30. (Currently amended) The method claimed in claim 28 or claim 29, wherein the step of __modifying__ [[changing]] is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

31. (Currently amended) The method claimed in claim 29 or claim 30, including the step of __modifying__ one or more of the investments [[changing one or more of the investments]] in response to said step of analysing so that the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments of the investment portfolio corresponds more closely, or less closely, to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of the benchmark risk category of the investor.

32. (Currently amended) The method claimed in claim 31, wherein the step of __modifying__ one or more of the investments [[changing one or more of the investments]] is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

33. (Original) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 32, including the step of forecasting the performance of the investment portfolio over a predetermined period for a predetermined amount of the investor's assets.

34. (Original) A method of creating an investment portfolio for an investor, including the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) selecting a plurality of investments for the investment portfolio; and (c) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 27, wherein said one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories represents the risk tolerance level of the investor.

35. (Original) A method of creating an investment portfolio for an investor, including the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) selecting a plurality of investments for the investment portfolio; and (c) managing the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 28 to 33, wherein said one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories represents the risk tolerance level of the investor.

36. (Original) The method claimed in claim 34 or claim 35, wherein the step of categorising is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

37. (Original) The method claimed in claim 34 or claim 35, wherein the step of selecting is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

38. (Original) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers.

39. (Original) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares.

40. (Currently amended) An analysis process, including comparing a distribution of assets of investments of an investment portfolio over one or more asset classes with a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes associated with a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein the comparing includes generating a visual representation of the comparison to enable assessment of risk alignment__.
